request.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity Chinese procurement-information detail screen for Client Reach, a minimal AI Agent research workspace. Flat full-frame front-facing desktop application, 16:9, designed at 1920x1080, crisp readable Chinese. This is a precise card-and-list research result, not a tender dashboard.

UNIFIED LOOK: white #FFFFFF / near-white #F7F8FA, graphite #20252C, muted gray #76808B, very fine #E7EAEE borders, extremely pale blue #EAF3FD selection, muted #597FA7 blue links. BLACK / WHITE / GRAY / LIGHT BLUE ONLY. No teal, purple, orange, gradients, gauges, pie charts, huge KPI tiles or sales funnel. Chinese text like Microsoft YaHei / Source Han Sans, good 14–16px body scale, quiet typography, 10px card radius, natural text wrapping and content-height panels.

SHELL: 176px pale gray left sidebar, black R square icon "Client Reach", small "Agent 工作台". EXACTLY THREE menus "工作台", "查询结果", "设置"; query results selected pale blue. Bottom tiny user "林 / 本地工作空间". Simple 56px global header "查询结果 / 企业详情", top right "公开研究快照 · 2026-10-08".

DETAIL HEADER: back link "← 返回查询结果"; monogram "比", title "比亚迪股份有限公司", tags "集团汇总", "公开采购样本". Quiet actions "导出资料", "继续研究". Immediately under identity show a beautiful three-option TOP DOCK pill with EXACT names "客户画像", "采购信息", "上下游关系". Procurement selected pale blue. Do NOT add these tabs to the sidebar.

SMALL SUMMARY ABOVE CONTENT: one restrained sentence "公开样本：11 个独立项目 · 15 条公告" and a small subtitle "2025-10-08 至 2026-10-08 · 需求数量不等于实际成交". These are textual summary, not big statistic blocks. Simple toolbar chips "全部买方", "全部品类", "按公告时间", small search "搜索产品或项目".

MAIN BODY: a 2-column layout, about 70% width for a flowing 2-column grid of FOUR natural-height procurement cards and 30% for a single "采购分析" list card. Card heights reflect data amounts; long buyer names wrap. Cards have clean headings, small date at top right, a subtle monochrome phase badge, short key/value lists, and source link footer. No large table, no fancy graph. Display ONLY these real records:

CARD A "智能体平台". Date "2026-08-28". Status "截止已过 · 结果未知". Rows "采购人：深圳市比亚迪锂电池有限公司", "需求：新增国产服务器 1 台", "规格：≤10U；≥16 张 GPU；单卡≥32GB", "未税预算：137 万元". Tiny note "现网 4 台服务器仅为调优对象". Source footer "诚E招原公告 ↗".

CARD B "气碎机". Date "2026-08-31". Status "截止已过 · 结果未知". Rows "采购人：惠州比亚迪电池有限公司", "需求：1 台", "规格：50kg/h；负极材料树脂碳；氮气内循环", "未税预算：160 万元". Source "诚E招原公告 ↗".

CARD C "软包三电极电池检测柜". Date "2026-05-13". Status "截止已过 · 结果未知". Rows "采购人：深圳市比亚迪锂电池有限公司", "需求：5 台", "规格：5V30A；16CH/台", "未税预算：46.5 万元". Small line "最终品牌型号未披露". Source "诚E招原公告 ↗".

CARD D "100Kg 硅沉积流化床". Date "二次招标 2026-07-28". Status "候选公示 · 未见最终结果". Rows "采购人：惠州比亚迪电池有限公司", "需求：1 台；单次加料 40–60kg", "未税预算：200 万元", "阶段：初次招标 → 二次招标 → 候选公示". Source "原公告及候选公示 ↗". Small note "同项目重招不计复购".

RIGHT ANALYSIS CARD, natural height and ample margins, exact heading "采购分析". Subheading "已取得的事实" with 3 short list items "两家实际买方", "材料制备与分析项目占样本 7/11", "8 个项目披露需求数量". Subheading "可判断的特征" with short sentences "存在设备与算力建设需求。" and "公告可比较规格与交货条件。" Then tiny label "基于公开样本". Subheading "仍需补充" with 3 clear rows "最终成交型号和数量", "实际复购周期", "下一次采购时间". A pale gray small note "缺少连续订单记录，不给复购概率". Bottom outline action "让 Agent 补查结果".

BOTTOM SMALL FOOTNOTE: "金额为原文元 / 万元口径，币种未明确；预算和候选报价不是成交额。" DO NOT put RMB symbol or currency code on these budgets. NO ongoing purchase label: all displayed tender deadlines have passed as of the research snapshot. NO fabricated deal probability or actual purchased quantity. Keep layout concise, calm, useful and card-based with natural height.

warnings: 第 1 张实际尺寸 1672x941 与请求 2048x1152 不一致。
